source: Doc 25 section 4.6: at least 4 optional jobs per chapter region (deliveries, surveys, maintenance, science runs), each with a sender and reason in Messages, paying in skill progress and crew notes, never story gates.

ranks.benefit: Route hints show gentle contour lines.
ranks.crew_line: Amara: Read the contours before your boots touch the slope.

ranks.benefit: Carry +1 survey marker on your back frame.
ranks.crew_line: Amara: A marker placed on the way out is a friend on the way home.

ranks.benefit: Carry +2 survey markers and wider route preview.
ranks.crew_line: Amara: You know this ridge like Expedition Zero's own cartographer.

ranks.benefit: +12% payload sway stability on Careful slopes.
ranks.crew_line: Kai: Keep the centre of mass close to your chest.

ranks.benefit: +24% payload sway stability and gentler set-downs.
ranks.crew_line: Kai: Smooth steps save fragile seals every single trip.

ranks.benefit: +36% payload sway stability on Steep ground.
ranks.crew_line: Kai: You could carry a tray of water across Shackleton rim without spilling a drop.

ranks.benefit: -5% suit oxygen, power and cooling burn through steady pacing.
ranks.crew_line: Rafi: Slow breaths on the climb keep your reserve green.

ranks.benefit: -10% suit budget burn and earlier reserve call-out.
ranks.crew_line: Rafi: Checklist discipline turns worry into margin.

ranks.benefit: -15% suit budget burn across all EVA sorties.
ranks.crew_line: Rafi: That's textbook EVA pacing — you always come back above the line.
Ferreira: Check the reference gauge before you touch a clamp.

ranks.benefit: Faster valve and breaker confirmation checks.
ranks.crew_line: Ferreira: Good engineers verify the trend, not just the noise.

ranks.benefit: Clearer connector pinout diagnostics on relays.
ranks.crew_line: Ferreira: You troubleshoot like a flight controller.

ranks.benefit: +4 m scanner pulse range and clearer plant notes.
ranks.crew_line: Mei: Look closely — small changes tell the whole story.

ranks.benefit: +8 m scanner pulse range and cold-shadow edge markers.
ranks.crew_line: Mei: Every shadow and leaf posture is data if we write it down.

ranks.benefit: +12 m scanner pulse range and full landmark readout.
ranks.crew_line: Mei: Nothing on this ridge or in the garden escapes your eye.

jobs.title: Check battery bus couplers
jobs.reason: Verify the battery jar couplers before sunset locks us on stored power.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Clean bus contacts mean zero surprise voltage drops tonight.

jobs.title: Log baseline leaf posture
jobs.reason: Record Alo's leaf angle under full lamp before the dark shifts start.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: A healthy leaf posture baseline tells us right away if cold creeps in.

jobs.title: Stage emergency ration packs
jobs.reason: Move two sealed ration packs to the Safe Room shelf before the drill.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: Staged supplies mean nobody scrambles when the alarm sounds.

jobs.title: Verify corridor pressure gauges
jobs.reason: Compare the corridor gauge against the air room tank readout.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Two gauges agreeing is how we sleep easy during a long night.

jobs.title: Inspect glove-port brush seal
jobs.reason: Check the pollen sleeve seal at the airlock glove port between runs.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: Dry pollen stays viable when the sleeve seal is tight.

jobs.title: Cycle airlock equalize valve
jobs.reason: Log the pump-down recovery time on the inner airlock door.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: Every liter of air we save in the lock stays in the station.

jobs.title: Carry spare nutrient cassettes
jobs.reason: Deliver two small nutrient cassettes from storage to the garden bench.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Steady hands keep the cassette membranes intact.

jobs.title: Chart apron shadow line
jobs.reason: Mark where the ridge shadow crosses the exterior apron walkway.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Knowing where shadow starts tells us when suit heaters kick in.

jobs.title: Torque corridor pipe clamps
jobs.reason: Recheck the trunk clamps after the shallow moonquake tremor.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: Shallow moonquakes ring for minutes — tight clamps stop secondary leaks.

jobs.title: Weigh dry-down seed pods
jobs.reason: Check moisture mass on the drying rack before opening Alo's pods.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: Seeds stored dry can wait years for their turn to grow.

jobs.title: Haul patch kit sled to annex hatch
jobs.reason: Move the seal patch kit to the old annex hatchway.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Having the sled at the hatch saves a trip in suits.

jobs.title: Survey Expedition Zero markers
jobs.reason: Log the bearings of the old survey stakes outside the annex.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Twelve-year-old stakes still point straight along the safe ridge.

jobs.title: Calibrate ridge beacon sightlines
jobs.reason: Verify line-of-sight angles between B1, B2 and B3 along the ridge.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: No blind corners means the rover never drives out of radio reach.

jobs.title: Load insulated cold-case on trailer
jobs.reason: Secure the cold-chain vault case in the rover trailer rack.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Strapped down tight, the cold-case won't shift on a 12-degree grade.

jobs.title: Sample rim frost temperature
jobs.reason: Log Diviner-band surface temperature at the cold-trap shadow boundary.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: Permanent shadow keeps water ice stable for billions of years.

jobs.title: Pre-heat rover wheel actuators
jobs.reason: Check actuator heater draw against the 30% return reserve.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Warm actuators and a 30% reserve bring the crew back every time.

jobs.title: Cross-check dual telescope frames
jobs.reason: Compare frame pairs to separate real meteoroid flashes from sensor cosmic rays.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: Two cameras agreeing turns a bright pixel into a confirmed impact.

jobs.title: Brush electrostatic dust from Mast A
jobs.reason: Clear levitated fines from the primary solar mast panels.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Clean cells recover our full +2 daylight margin right away.

jobs.title: Carry dome seal tape to garden
jobs.reason: Deliver the pressure-seal inspection kit to the garden dome.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: The cotton seedling needs steady pressure while its first leaves open.

jobs.title: Log ejecta bearing on rim lookout
jobs.reason: Sight the fresh impact flash azimuth from the crater-rim lookout.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Bearings from two known points pin down the impact site on the map.

jobs.title: Isolate corroded array busbar
jobs.reason: Check the relay contact resistance before Earth's shadow covers the ridge.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Isolating the bad branch keeps the battery from draining into a fault.

jobs.title: Record red-ring refraction spectrum
jobs.reason: Capture the copper-red twilight light refracted through Earth's atmosphere.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: Every sunrise and sunset on Earth shines together in that red ring.

jobs.title: Place path lights along array walk
jobs.reason: Set low-draw markers along the mast walkway before totality.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: A lit path lets us walk the array line in full eclipse darkness.

jobs.title: Stage thermal blankets in garden
jobs.reason: Pre-position thermal wraps before the five-hour eclipse chill.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: Pre-warming the chamber saves battery when solar input drops to zero.

jobs.title: Verify dosimeter alarm thresholds
jobs.reason: Check the personal dosimeter against the Safe Room wall monitor.
jobs.crew_note: Rafi: ALARA starts with knowing the exact flux curve before we step outside.

jobs.title: Lock water-wall bladders in place
jobs.reason: Confirm all Safe Room water bladders and crate latches are seated.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Mass between us and the sky is the best friend we have in a storm.

jobs.title: Test backup S-band relay coupler
jobs.reason: Verify the secondary relay coupler while the direct Earth link is noisy.
jobs.crew_note: Ferreira: When direct DTE fades, the relay path keeps our voice alive.

jobs.title: Log cotton bud resilience post-peak
jobs.reason: Check the garden sensors after the proton flux peak passes.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: Keeping heat and water steady brought every plant through the storm.

jobs.title: Confirm Ch 4 beacon layer on road map
jobs.reason: Overlay the October cold-trap beacons onto the Malapert relay route.
jobs.crew_note: Amara: The markers we built months ago still guide our wheels today.

jobs.title: Carry summit controller up the spur
jobs.reason: Haul the replacement relay controller up the graded Malapert summit path.
jobs.crew_note: Kai: Steady footing on the last climb — this box carries everyone's voice.

jobs.title: Seat dual-link transceiver harness
jobs.reason: Verify both local station link and Earth desk bearings on the summit mast.
jobs.crew_note: Ferreira: Twelve years later, the lighthouse is finally shining both ways.

jobs.title: Archive full-season seed & sky ledger
jobs.reason: Record the complete seed lineage and horizon ephemeris for the Academy.
jobs.crew_note: Mei: From two seeds in a tin to a living Moon garden — every step is written here.
